_method: Main agent (Opus) ran its OWN WebSearches to independently re-judge the strongest survivor and the strongest rejections, rather than trusting subagent verdicts. Records only results actually seen (R5).

key_results_seen: [2604.00135] Temperature Control of Digital Glass Forming Processes (submitted 2026-03-31, Tiwari et al.) - REAL. Thermal+visual camera sync, data-driven dynamic temperature model, closed-loop laser-power controller to hold glass working range. Industrial digital/laser glass forming, NOT artisan glassblowing; closed-loop control, NOT neural-operator forward forecast.

checks.my_verdict: GAP_NARROW confirmed, leaning crowded. The broad problem (hold molten glass in the workable temperature/viscosity band via thermal-camera + data-driven model) IS occupied (2604.00135 for industrial DGF; cation-fingerprint ANN for glass viscosity). The genuinely-unused slice is thin: a neural-operator forward-rollout surrogate aimed at real-time ARTISAN hand-glassblowing reheat decisions. Not OPEN; not fully CLOSED.
checks.agreement: AGREE with subagent (NARROW), with the caveat that the candidate's 'no instrument feeds the working state' premise is weaker than stated for the industrial case.

checks.my_verdict: GAP_CLOSED confirmed. The phone-photo -> count -> treatment-decision pipeline is a shipping open-source tool + peer-reviewed paper. Rejection is sound; swapping in Molmo2 would be a method change, not a first application.

crosscheck_conclusion: Independent re-judgment AGREES with the aggregate: 0 GAP_OPEN, 6 GAP_NARROW, 4 GAP_CLOSED. No verdict overturned. Grounded-gap finding (R7): every remaining NARROW gap is of the form 'specific fresh-technique capability not yet tried' on a problem whose BROADER framing is already AI-served (often by a 2023-2026 paper or a shipping app) - it is NOT 'problem untouched'. This reproduces the Run 22/23 lesson at the application layer: fresh technique + under-served domain still tends to find the application target partially occupied, because obvious applications get picked off fast and any documented open problem attracts some ML attention.
